svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap: cut a 300 mm disc from 1.5 mm sheet (150 mm radius). Cut out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 48 degree wedge to the centre, roll the rest into a cone 260 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across with a 30 degree slope, and rivet the overlap (three rivets).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: three 142 mm lengths of 20 x 3 mm flat bar, each bent

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90 degrees 30 mm from one end to make a foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rivet each leg's long part to the outside of the flue top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 degrees apart, two 4.8 mm rivets, so the bent feet stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 52 mm above the flue's top edge. Rivet the cap to the feet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The shortest gap from the flue's top edge to the cap is 60 mm:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: never less, or it chokes the draft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the gap under the cap is the same all round.
